# Eight Determinations — The Complete Traversal

## #0 — One relation before its turns

The eight determinations are one relation traversed from threshold to return. They are not eight neighbouring concepts and not eight labels laid over an already completed system.

Their complete order is:

$$
/=-/-
\;\longrightarrow\;
0/1
\;\longrightarrow\;
?/!
\;\longrightarrow\;
-/+
\;\longrightarrow\;
X/x
\;\longrightarrow\;
AM/IS
\;\longrightarrow\;
\infty/dx
\;\longrightarrow\;
1/0.
$$

The middle six are the qualitative body of Quaternal Logic. The first and last are its threshold and return. This is why the count is not an eight-position alternative to the sixfold. The sixfold is generated as

$$
2+2^2=4+2=6,
$$

two implicate poles and four explicate relations. The eightfold gives that sixfold its full passage: the unnamed parent-relation before the count, the six determinations through which a knowing act becomes articulate, and the inversion by which the achieved articulation turns toward the condition that made it possible.

The same relation changes its office at every turn. A bare relation becomes conscious circumstance; circumstance becomes question and assertion; determination acquires force; force becomes recognisable recurrence; recurrence becomes personed context; situated knowing opens onto an inexhaustible horizon; the achieved field returns toward the ground it cannot contain.

The problem remains one throughout: **how can determination become exact, answerable and capable of recognition without turning the condition of determination into one more determined object?**

The two Spanda readings disclose the whole before its local turns are separated. The first reads the sixfold horizontally, through emanation and return:

$$
0
\rightarrow
(0/0)
\rightarrow
\left(\frac{0/1}{1/0}\right)
\rightarrow
[T_0]
\rightarrow
[T_1]
\rightarrow
(1/0+0/1)
\rightarrow
1/1=1=100\%.
$$

The second reads the achieved whole vertically, by its own internal accounting:

$$
100\%
=
2^6+6^2
=
64+36
\rightarrow
\frac{2^6}{6^2}
\rightarrow
/4
\rightarrow
\frac{16}{9}
=
\frac{2^4}{3^2}
\rightarrow
4+2.
$$

The first supplies the horizontal relation of the six; the second supplies their four-explicate / two-implicate constitution. Their difference is productive. A 4+2 without relational passage is a catalogue; a 3:3 without constituted positions is proportion without anything definite to proportion. Held together they become a logic: countable and relational at once.

The complete derivation is carried by Core Theorems — Pithy. What follows keeps that depth alive at the Symbolon root instead of reducing it to an index.

## #1 — Relation becomes circumstance and answer

The parent relation is

$$
/=-/-.
$$

Two unassigned marks occupy different places and are read together. Their difference is positional before it is qualitative. The slash therefore does not arrive after two finished terms as a third thing between them. The terms become readable as terms through the relating.

That parent acquires its first determinate orientation as

$$
0/1.
$$

Zero names the open, unobjectifiable fact of awareness: the condition in which any mark can appear. One names the appearing mark and, with it, the relational field opened by appearance. The first mark is already more than an isolated unit. It has an edge, excludes alternatives, can recur, can be compared, and belongs to a circumstance in which it counts as this rather than that.

The slash keeps the two directions of dependence distinct. Appearance is given in awareness; awareness becomes manifest and knowable through appearing. The One is not another item inside the All, and the All is not an inventory which could finally add the One to itself. Their relation is manifestation.

This is the first form of the Two Ones: **One as unobjectifiable singleness; All as articulated multiplicity.**

The same circumstance becomes answerable as

$$
?/!.
$$

A question already marks. “What is this?” distinguishes enough of an appearance to address it. An assertion remains answerable. “This is …” commits the field to a determination whose truth still depends on whether it runs true to what called for it.

Question and assertion therefore belong to one operation. The question is not empty indecision, because it has already taken a provisional this. The assertion is not self-grounding closure, because what it says can still be changed by what it has marked. Definition begins here as **answerable determination**.

The first harmonic is consequently Being: conscious circumstance becomes something that can be called to account. Ground and definition are not separate topics. The field is present; the field can be marked; the mark remains within the field whose appearing made marking possible.

[The Slash](the-slash.md), [0/1](0-1.md), and [Question / Assertion](question-assertion.md) carry these first turns in their own sixfold forms.

## #2 — Difference acquires force and form

A mark that matters has consequences. The relation therefore becomes

$$
-/+.
$$

Withdrawal and extension, reserve and issue, contraction and release are two directions of one differentiating movement. A contraction without extension would never appear; an extension without reserve would have no difference through which to become determinate.

This is the seed of Spanda. Breath gathers and releases. Attention contracts around a word and opens into sense. A distinction is held and then made consequential. The poles are not two independent substances in conflict. Their tension is the activity through which a difference becomes operative.

Force then becomes recognisable by recurring:

$$
X/x.
$$

Capital X is determining capacity: the pattern, type, presiding possibility, or anything-by-which a local particular can be read. Lower-case x is its temporal face. The same letter in two cases keeps the instance from being severed from the capacity it manifests without allowing one instance to exhaust that capacity.

The lower-case x also keeps multiplication alive. An instance can recur, compound and become another one of those. Pattern is therefore where force acquires memory: a rhythm can return, a form can be recognised, a thought can be taken up again, an identity can survive change of presentation.

This is the second harmonic, Becoming. Force becomes intelligible as recurrence, while recurrence remains alive only as force capable of another instance.

The geometric reading grows from the same distinction between poles and relational states. The singles carry qualitative polarity; the doubles carry the four explicit relations:

$$
00,\;01,\;10,\;11.
$$

Together they yield the 4+2. Their ordering is not a smooth neutral circuit. The passage from 01 to 10 reverses the orientation: expression meets inverse, one reading crosses to the other. The phase-flip is therefore already active within the generated body before the global return at 5→0.

This is why the sixfold cannot be taught as six boxes. Its positions are generated by the self-relation of the original distinction, and the inversion which returns the whole is already latent in the way the middle terms exchange orientation.

[−/+](minus-plus.md) and [X/x](X-x.md) unfold these turns directly.

## #3 — Pattern becomes person and horizon

A recognisable pattern enters a lived world as

$$
AM/IS.
$$

AM is first-person presence: I am. IS is third-person sayability: it is, she is, this is. The slash is the second-person relation through which presence and predication meet. An account can describe someone exactly and still remain an account about them. Address opens the different possibility that the one described answers and changes the terms of the description.

Context is the lived where of that encounter: body, memory, language, concern, history, task, world and relation. It is total in involvement because nothing appears outside some horizon of appearing. It is incidental in ordinary attention because the horizon usually accompanies what appears rather than presenting itself as another object beside it.

The personed determination makes the three offices of knowing explicit:

- pramātṛ — the knower;
- pramāṇa — the means, the relating through which knowing occurs;
- prameya — the known.

They belong to one appearing-act without becoming interchangeable. The means can become known; an account of the means can become extremely rich; the knower-pole is not thereby converted into another item in the account. This distinction is not an after-the-fact caution. It is what the theorem has been showing from the first relation: the condition of determination remains implicated in determination without becoming one more product of it.

The same personed knowing then reaches

$$
\infty/dx.
$$

Infinity names the inexhaustible horizon no finite mark contains. The differential names exact local difference, the minute determination through which change becomes readable. Their relation says that local exactness is real while local exactness does not possess the whole condition from which it is taken.

The calculus makes this precise. Differentiation yields local change while losing the additive constant. Integration restores not one self-grounding whole but a family:

$$
F(x)+C.
$$

The local derivative does not contain the information required to choose one member of that family. A further condition is required. The missing C is therefore a formal image of provenance: **what is locally exact need not contain the whole condition of its own exactness.**

This is Knowing/unKnowing. Personed predication becomes exact without pretending to become total. The limit is not a retreat from knowledge. It is part of what makes the knowledge faithful.

[AM/IS](AM-IS.md) and [∞/dx](infinity-dx.md) carry this harmonic.

## #4 — The sixfold recognises its own structure

The six determinations can now be read in more than one direction because enough of their operation has been generated to disclose their internal grammar.

The vertical reading is

$$
4:2,
$$

four explicate relational positions and two implicate poles.

The horizontal reading is

$$
3:3,
$$

whose primary meaning comes from the personed structure. The first pass, 1–2–3, follows first-, second-, and third-person perspective. The second pass, 4–5–0, voids the isolation of those perspectives, recognises their unity, and returns that unity as 0/1. Three perspectives are answered by three operations of one recognition. In that specific sense,

$$
3:3=3:1.
$$

Later bimba/pratibimba, emanation/reversion, physical/mental and musical readings inherit this personed structure. They do not generate it.

Across the sixfold, the forward harmonics are:

- **Being** — Ground with Definition: 0/1 with ?/!;
- **Becoming** — Dynamis with Pattern: −/+ with X/x;
- **Knowing/unKnowing** — Context with Realisation: AM/IS with ∞/dx.

Across these forward pairs run three complementary folds:

- **Essence** — #0 with #5: conscious circumstance with unbounded differential depth;
- **Constitution** — #1 with #4: answerable definition with the personed world in which questioning and asserting occur;
- **Text–Texture** — #2 with #3: felt force with readable pattern.

These are not six new meanings placed on top of the determinations. They are the relations the determinations disclose when the traversal is read forward and across itself.

The crossed-zero sequence gives the same sixfold another turn: the mediating instrument progressively recognising its own participation in the field it had taken as subject and object.

$$
0
\rightarrow
Ø
\rightarrow
X
\rightarrow
Ø/X
\rightarrow
(0/Ø)/(1/X)
\rightarrow
1.
$$

At the beginning, the kartṛ-pole is bracketing-prior. At Ø the slash is fused into the apparent self: the instrument's own activity is occluded and the bound subject appears as though it were a self-grounding singular thing. X is the object-world cut, named and discriminated through vikalpa. At Ø/X the slash becomes visible as medium. At (0/Ø)/(1/X), subject-side recognition and object-side recognition are held together as a relation of relations, a field of availability. At 1 the achieved unity is affirmed.

The movement is not from falsehood to a new object called truth. It is the same field becoming increasingly transparent to the mediating operation through which its poles were available in the first place.

[Subject Logics](subject-logics.md) develops this recognition reading.

## #5→0 — The achieved field turns through its ground

The eightfold completes when the achieved determination meets its inverse orientation:

$$
1/0.
$$

This is not a seventh position inside the sixfold. It is the return-switch through which the counted body turns toward the condition it presupposed.

The arithmetic asymmetry supplies the pressure. 0/1 settles; 1/0 does not compute in ordinary arithmetic. The two orientations are related but not interchangeable. The mark can be held in the ground; the ground cannot be exhausted by the mark's attempt to proportion itself to that ground.

This gives the whole system its chirality. The return is not a mirror image with all values reversed symmetrically. The forward direction can resolve a local determination. The reverse direction remains open because the finite cannot make the condition of finitude one more finite possession.

Recognition therefore differs from acquisition. The return is pratyabhijñā: the achieved field recognises the relation through which its achievement occurred.

The crossed-zero movement now closes:

$$
0
\rightarrow
Ø
\rightarrow
X
\rightarrow
Ø/X
\rightarrow
(0/Ø)/(1/X)
\rightarrow
1
\;\circlearrowleft\;
0/1.
$$

What appeared at Ø as an isolated self is recognised at 1 as an achieved unity whose ground was never the isolated mark itself. The final return to 0/1 does not uncover a hidden object behind experience. It recognises manifestation itself as the relation of kartṛ and kārya, knower and articulated field, through the means that had been active throughout.

This is the force of

$$
5\rightarrow0.
$$

The end becomes a condition of another beginning, carrying its acquired difference rather than cancelling it. The determination returns with a history. The ground is not restored as blankness but recognised as the source-relation through which the differentiated field has become capable of another act.

Read continuously, the eight determinations therefore say:

A relation precedes the terms it differentiates.  
Conscious circumstance appears as 0/1.  
Appearance becomes answerable as ?/!.  
Answerable marking acquires force as −/+.  
Force becomes recognisable recurrence as X/x.  
Recurrence becomes personed context as AM/IS.  
Situated knowing becomes exact against an inexhaustible horizon as ∞/dx.  
The achieved determination turns toward its own condition as 1/0 and returns through recognition to 0/1.

The invariance is not a hidden object carried unchanged behind the sequence. What persists is the relation itself: the condition of determination remains active in every determination without becoming one more product of the determining act.

[1/0](1-0.md) carries the returning orientation. [Self-Identity](self-identity.md), [Mono/Poly](mono-poly.md), and [Complexio Oppositorum](complexio-oppositorum.md) take different consequences of the same completed traversal into their own sixfold movements.
